find:
const sameSlots =
        next.stocks.length === prev.stocks.length && next.stocks.every((s) => before.has(s.slot));
killedBy: live status announcements (issue #629) does not read a DIFFERENT match’s lower stock as a loss in this one
why: Drops the guard that the two pushes describe the SAME match. A two-player match replaced by a four-player one gives slot 0 fewer stocks than it had, and the pane announces a stock loss nobody suffered -- at the start of a match, which is the worst moment to be told someone is losing. The slot set is what distinguishes a new match from a loss within one, since versus carries no mission number to change.
